findings.where: Tables 7.7a-d, October 2026, footnotes and notes; visually inspected rendered pages
quotes: Data are at end of period.
findings.meaning: Net summer capacity; predominant source attribution for multifuel plants. Solar includes thermal and PV, excludes small-scale PV. All-sector and electric-power histories through 1988 cover electric utilities only; from 1989 include the additional producers described in each table. Hydro includes pumped storage through 1988; solar is in wind through 1988; wood includes waste through 1984; waste includes nonrenewable material through 2000. These are historical scope changes, not a stable total across all years.

findings.where: State Energy Data System 2024 Energy indicators, printed pages 6-7
quotes: EIA’s net summer capacity data are for utility-scale (>1 megawatt capacity) facilities only
findings.meaning: All 17 listed capacity definitions use net summer capacity, exclude small-scale systems, assign multifuel plants to predominant fuel, and report year-end values. Net summer is different from nameplate and winter capacity. US source is MER December; state source is State Electricity Profiles. Keep source threshold wording verbatim in evidence; display utility-scale, not an invented numeric boundary.

NUGBPUS is separate nuclear operable-unit net summer capacity. Full-power license/equivalent permission defines operable population. From 2011 monthly capacity adds reported uprates/derates, then assigns the difference from final EIA-860 year-end capacity to January. Do not apply MER Table 7.7 utility-only-through-1988 notes to this separate series.

findings.where: Table 6.2.B, August 2026 and 2025, column groups and notes
quotes: Capacity From Utility and Small Scale Facilities
findings.meaning: Published US and state solar totals include utility-scale PV, solar thermal and estimated small-scale PV. Broader solar total exists. This is distinct from estimated total solar PV. Alabama small-scale and combined columns are NM, not numerical zero. API availability remains unverified; do not substitute utility-scale as whole where broader compatible total exists, and do not invent a sum or off-API retrieval.
